product: 初中英语课本章节同步训练
note: 人教版 Go for it 七至九年级共 58 单元；每单元含重点词汇、语法要点与同步练习；词汇音频来自单词库或 /audio/jw/x<word>.mp3

units.title: Starter Unit 1 Good morning!

words.sentence: I get up at six in the morning.
Thank you for helping me with my maths.

grammars.point: 打招呼用语按时间分为 Good morning! / Good afternoon! / Good evening!，回答重复原句即可。
grammars.example: Good morning, Miss Gao!
grammars.exampleCn: 早上好，高老师！

grammars.point: 初次见面用 I'm... 或 My name is... 自我介绍，用 This is... 介绍他人。
grammars.example: Hello! I'm Gina. Nice to meet you!
grammars.exampleCn: 你好！我是吉娜。很高兴认识你！

questions.stem: 早上 8 点见到老师，你应该说：___
questions.analysis: 早上用 Good morning，晚上分别用 evening / night。

questions.stem: —How are you? —___, thank you.
questions.analysis: How are you 问身体好吗，用 Fine 回答。

questions.stem: "这是我的朋友。" 的英文是：___
questions.analysis: 介绍他人用 This is + 人。

units.title: Starter Unit 2 What's this in English?

words.sentence: We found the museum easily with a map.
words.sentenceCn: 有地图我们很容易找到了博物馆。

grammars.point: 问"这个用英语怎么说"用 What's this in English? 回答用 It's a/an...。
grammars.example: What's this in English? It's an orange.
grammars.exampleCn: 这个用英语怎么说？是一个橙子。

grammars.point: 单数名词前用 a 或 an：辅音音素开头用 a，元音音素开头用 an。
grammars.example: a pen, a map, an apple, an egg
grammars.exampleCn: 一支钢笔、一张地图、一个苹果、一个鸡蛋

questions.stem: ___ is a ruler. 指着远处的东西应该说：___
questions.analysis: that 指远处，this 指近处。

questions.stem: ___ apple（选冠词）
questions.analysis: apple 以元音音素 /æ/ 开头，用 an。

questions.stem: —What's this in English? —___ a key.
questions.analysis: 回答 What's this 用 It's a/an...

units.title: Starter Unit 3 What color is it?

grammars.point: 问颜色用 What color is it? 回答 It's + 颜色。
grammars.example: What color is the pen? It's blue.
grammars.exampleCn: 这支钢笔是什么颜色？是蓝色的。

grammars.point: 颜色词既可作表语（The car is black.）也可作定语（a black car）。
grammars.example: The quilt is white. It's a white quilt.
grammars.exampleCn: 这床被子是白色的。是一床白色的被子。

questions.stem: —What color is the orange? —It's ___.
questions.analysis: orange 作颜色时是形容词，前面不加冠词。

questions.stem: 黑白相间的英语是：___
questions.analysis: 固定表达为 black and white。

questions.stem: The sky（天空）is ___.
questions.analysis: 天空是蓝色的。

units.title: Unit 1 My name's Gina.
units.topic: 自我介绍与 be 动词

words.sentence: My family has four people.
A real friend helps you when you are in trouble.
words.sentenceCn: 真正的朋友在你困难时会帮你。

grammars.point: be 动词搭配口诀：我用 am，你用 are，is 跟着他她它；单数名词用 is，复数名词全用 are。
grammars.example: I am a student. She is my teacher. They are my friends.
grammars.exampleCn: 我是学生。她是我的老师。他们是我的朋友。

grammars.point: 形容词性物主代词 my/your/his/her 后面必须跟名词。
grammars.example: My name is Jack. Her name is Alice.
grammars.exampleCn: 我的名字叫杰克。她的名字叫爱丽丝。

questions.stem: I ___ Gina. 选be动词
questions.analysis: I 后面用 am。

questions.stem: ___ name is Bob.___ is my friend.
questions.analysis: 第一空后有名词 name 用形容词性 His，第二空作主语用主格 He。

questions.stem: —Is she your sister? —Yes, ___ is.
questions.analysis: 问 she 答 she。

units.title: Unit 2 This is my sister.

words.sentence: His sister studies in a middle school.
words.sentenceCn: 他姐姐在一所中学读书。

words.sentence: My brother is two years older than me.

words.meaning: 父亲；母亲（常用复数 parents）
words.sentence: My parents are both teachers.
Grandma tells me stories every night.
My cousin and I are in the same school.
words.sentenceCn: 我表哥和我在同一所学校。

grammars.point: 介绍多人用 These are... / Those are...，后面的名词要用复数。
grammars.example: These are my parents. Those are my grandparents.
grammars.exampleCn: 这些是我的父母。那些是我的祖父母。

grammars.point: 名词复数规则变化：一般加 -s；以 s/x/ch/sh 结尾加 -es；辅音字母+y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 -es。
grammars.example: book→books, box→boxes, family→families
grammars.exampleCn: 书→books，盒子→boxes，家庭→families

questions.stem: This is my ___ and those are my ___.（姐妹们；父母）
questions.analysis: those 后用复数，this is 后用单数。

questions.stem: I have three ___（钥匙）。
questions.analysis: 以辅音音素结尾加 s，key 直接加 s。

questions.stem: ___ are my brothers.
questions.analysis: brothers 是复数，指示代词用 Those。

units.title: Unit 3 Is this your pencil?
units.topic: 一般疑问句与物主代词

words.sentence: Look up the new word in your dictionary.
words.sentenceCn: 在词典里查一下这个生词。

words.sentence: You can borrow three books from the library.
words.sentenceCn: 你可以从图书馆借三本书。

grammars.point: 一般疑问句 Is this/that your...? 肯定回答 Yes, it is. 否定回答 No, it isn't.
grammars.example: Is this your schoolbag? Yes, it is. It's mine.
grammars.exampleCn: 这是你的书包吗？是的。是我的。

grammars.point: 名词性物主代词 mine/yours/his/hers 单独使用，后面不再跟名词；= 形容词性物主代词 + 名词。
grammars.example: This pen is mine. That one is yours.
grammars.exampleCn: 这支钢笔是我的。那支是你的。

questions.stem: Is that your eraser? —No, it isn't. It's ___（她的）。
questions.analysis: 空后无名词，用名词性物主代词 hers。

questions.stem: ___ that your dictionary?
questions.analysis: that 是单数，用 Is。

questions.stem: This is ___ schoolbag.（我的）
questions.analysis: 空后有名词 schoolbag，用形容词性 my。

units.title: Unit 4 Where's my schoolbag?

grammars.point: where 引导特殊疑问句问地点，回答用方位介词短语。
grammars.example: Where are my keys? They're on the table.
grammars.exampleCn: 我的钥匙在哪里？在桌子上。

grammars.point: 方位介词 in（在……里）、on（在……上）、under（在……下）。
grammars.example: The ball is in the box, on the box and under the chair.
grammars.exampleCn: 球在盒子里、盒子上和椅子下面。

questions.stem: The cat is ___ the bed.（在床底下）
questions.analysis: 在……下面用 under。

questions.stem: —___ is my hat? —It's on your head.
questions.analysis: 问地点用 Where。

questions.stem: His keys are ___ the drawer（抽屉）.
questions.analysis: 在抽屉里用 in。

units.title: Unit 5 Do you have a soccer ball?

words.sentence: The boys are playing basketball on the playground.
words.sentenceCn: 男孩子们正在操场上打篮球。

grammars.point: have 表示"拥有"，第三人称单数用 has；一般疑问句用 Do/Does 提前。
grammars.example: I have a basketball. She has a soccer ball. Do you have a ping-pong bat?
grammars.exampleCn: 我有一个篮球。她有一个足球。你有乒乓球拍吗？

grammars.point: 助动词 do/does 构成否定和疑问：主语三单用 does，其余用 do；后接动词原形。
grammars.example: He doesn't have a volleyball. Does Tom have a tennis ball?
grammars.exampleCn: 他没有排球。汤姆有网球吗？

questions.stem: She ___ a nice schoolbag.
questions.analysis: 第三人称单数用 has。

questions.stem: ___ you have a soccer ball? —Yes, I do.
questions.analysis: 主语 you 用 Do。

questions.stem: Tom ___ have a tennis ball.（否定）
questions.analysis: 主语 Tom 是三单，否定用 doesn't + 动词原形。

units.title: Unit 6 Do you like bananas?

words.sentence: People in the south live on rice.

grammars.point: like 表示喜好，三单用 likes；可数名词复数表示一类事物。
grammars.example: I like apples. He likes ice-cream.
grammars.exampleCn: 我喜欢苹果。他喜欢冰淇淋。

grammars.point: 可数名词有单复数（an apple / two apples）；不可数名词没有复数（rice, milk, chicken 鸡肉）。
grammars.example: I have two eggs and some rice.
grammars.exampleCn: 我有两个鸡蛋和一些米饭。

questions.stem: Tom likes ___（草莓）very much.
questions.analysis: 以辅音字母+y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 es。

questions.stem: Do you like ___?（鸡肉）
questions.analysis: 鸡肉不可数，用原形。

questions.stem: ___ she like carrots? —Yes, she does.
questions.analysis: 主语 she 是三单，用 Does。

units.title: Unit 7 How much are these socks?

words.sentence: This dictionary is cheap but useful.

grammars.point: how much 问价格：单数用 How much is...?，复数用 How much are...?
grammars.example: How much is this sweater? How much are these socks?
grammars.exampleCn: 这件毛衣多少钱？这些短袜多少钱？

grammars.point: 成双成对的名词（socks, trousers, shoes）作主语时谓语动词用复数。
grammars.example: The trousers are thirty dollars.
grammars.exampleCn: 这条裤子三十美元。

questions.stem: —How much ___ the trousers? —___ twenty dollars.
questions.analysis: trousers 复数，用 are，代词用 They're。

questions.stem: The socks are only two ___（美元）。
questions.analysis: two 后用复数 dollars。

questions.stem: This hat is nice. I'll take ___.
questions.analysis: hat 单数，用 it 代替。

units.title: Unit 8 When is your birthday?

words.sentence: Welcome to my birthday party this Saturday.
words.sentenceCn: 欢迎这周六来我的生日聚会。

grammars.point: 日期用序数词表达：first(1st), second(2nd), third(3rd), twelfth(12th), twentieth(20th)。
grammars.example: My birthday is on June third./on June 3rd.
grammars.exampleCn: 我的生日在六月三日。

grammars.point: 问生日用 When is your birthday? 回答用 on + 日期；月份首字母必须大写。
grammars.example: When is your birthday? It's on May 1st.
grammars.exampleCn: 你的生日是什么时候？五月一日。

questions.stem: Teachers' Day is in ___.（九月）
questions.analysis: 九月是 September。

questions.stem: Today is her ___ birthday.（十二岁）
questions.analysis: 序数词 twelfth 表示第十二个生日。

questions.stem: —___ is the school trip? —It's on October 10th.
questions.analysis: 问日期用 When。

units.title: Unit 9 My favorite subject is science.

words.sentence: Farmers are busy in autumn.
Are you free this Sunday evening?

grammars.point: What's your favorite subject? = What subject do you like best?
grammars.example: What's your favorite subject? My favorite subject is P.E.
grammars.exampleCn: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？我最喜欢的科目是体育。

grammars.point: why 问原因，because 回答；because 后跟完整的句子。
grammars.example: Why do you like music? Because it's relaxing.
grammars.exampleCn: 你为什么喜欢音乐？因为它令人放松。

questions.stem: ___ do you like science? —Because it's interesting.
questions.analysis: because 回答的是原因，提问用 Why。

questions.stem: My favorite subject ___ English.
questions.analysis: subject 单数用 is。

questions.stem: Music is ___. I like it very much.
questions.analysis: 前后语义一致，喜欢说明音乐令人放松。

units.title: Unit 1 Can you play the guitar?

words.sentence: She sings English songs very well.

grammars.point: can 表能力，后接动词原形，没有人称和数的变化；否定 can't，疑问把 can 提前。
grammars.example: She can sing and dance. Can you play chess? No, I can't.
grammars.exampleCn: 她会唱歌跳舞。你会下棋吗？不会。

grammars.point: play + the + 乐器（play the piano）；play + 球类（play football）不加 the。
grammars.example: Tom can play the guitar but he can't play the drums.
grammars.exampleCn: 汤姆会弹吉他但不会打架子鼓。

questions.stem: Can you ___ the piano?
questions.analysis: can 后接动词原形。

questions.stem: The boys often ___ basketball after school.
questions.analysis: 球类前不加 the。

questions.stem: —Can Mary swim? —___. She is afraid of water.
questions.analysis: can 引导的问句用 can 回答；怕水说明不会。

units.title: Unit 2 What time do you go to school?

words.sentence: We usually have a meeting on Monday.
The early bird catches the worm.
He never tells a lie.

grammars.point: what time 问具体时刻；整点用 o'clock，半小时可用 half past 或直接"数字+thirty"。
grammars.example: What time do you usually get up? At six thirty.
grammars.exampleCn: 你通常几点起床？六点半。

grammars.point: 频率副词（always/usually/often/sometimes/never）位于实义动词之前、be 动词之后。
grammars.example: He never eats breakfast. She is always late.
grammars.exampleCn: 他从不吃早餐。她总是迟到。

questions.stem: I usually go to school ___ seven o'clock.
questions.analysis: 具体时刻前用 at。

questions.stem: My father ___ watches TV at night.（从不）
questions.analysis: 从不 = never。
差一刻到七点用 a quarter to seven。

units.title: Unit 3 How do you get to school?

words.sentence: Subway is a fast way to travel in Beijing.
words.sentenceCn: 在北京，地铁是快捷的出行方式。

words.sentence: The train arrives at Platform 2.
Riding a bicycle is good exercise.
words.sentenceCn: 骑自行车是很好的锻炼。

words.sentence: Wait a minute, please.
The river runs through our city.
words.sentenceCn: 这条河穿过我们的城市。

grammars.point: 问交通方式用 How do you get to...? 回答用 by + 交通工具或 take + the + 交通工具。
grammars.example: How does Mary get to school? She rides a bike. / She goes by bike.
grammars.exampleCn: 玛丽怎么去上学？她骑自行车。

grammars.point: how long 问时长，how far 问距离。
grammars.example: How long does it take? About 15 minutes. How far is it from home to school? About two kilometers.
grammars.exampleCn: 花多长时间？大约15分钟。从家到学校多远？大约两公里。

questions.stem: I go to school ___ bus every day.
questions.analysis: by + 交通工具中间不加任何词。

questions.stem: ___ does it take to get to the station?
questions.analysis: take 花费时间，用 How long 提问。

questions.stem: Some students ___ a boat to cross the river.
questions.analysis: 作谓语动词用 take，by 是介词不能作谓语。

units.title: Unit 4 Don't eat in class.

words.sentence: Follow the school rules, please.

grammars.point: 祈使句以动词原形开头，否定形式 Don't + 动词原形。
grammars.example: Listen carefully in class. Don't run in the hallways.
grammars.exampleCn: 课上认真听讲。不要在走廊里奔跑。

grammars.point: have to 表客观必须，有人称和时态变化；must 表主观必须，没有人称变化。
grammars.example: I have to wear a uniform at school. We must be quiet in the library.
grammars.exampleCn: 在学校我必须穿校服。在图书馆我们必须保持安静。

questions.stem: ___ eat in the classroom.
questions.analysis: 祈使句否定用 Don't + 动词原形。

questions.stem: Students ___ be on time for class.（必须）
questions.analysis: 主语 Students 复数，have to 用原形。

questions.stem: We must ___ in the library.
questions.analysis: must 后接动词原形。

units.title: Unit 5 Why do you like pandas?

words.sentence: Our new teacher is very friendly.
words.sentenceCn: 我们的新老师非常友好。

grammars.point: why 提问用 because 回答；because 后接表示原因的完整句子。
grammars.example: Why do you like pandas? Because they're kind of interesting.
grammars.exampleCn: 你为什么喜欢熊猫？因为它们有点儿有趣。

grammars.point: kind of 意为"有点儿"，修饰形容词；kinds of 意为"种类的"。
grammars.example: Koalas are kind of shy. There are many kinds of animals in the zoo.
grammars.exampleCn: 考拉有点儿害羞。动物园里有许多种动物。

questions.stem: Lions are ___（有点吓人的）。
questions.analysis: kind of + 形容词。

questions.stem: —___ do you like giraffes? —Because they're beautiful.
questions.analysis: because 对应用 Why 提问。

questions.stem: Elephants can remember places ___ food.（有）
questions.analysis: with 表示带有。

units.title: Unit 6 I'm watching TV.

words.sentence: Children need at least eight hours' sleep.
words.sentenceCn: 儿童需要至少八小时的睡眠。

grammars.point: 现在进行时 = be + V-ing，表示此刻正在进行的动作。
grammars.example: Look! They are playing soccer. Listen! Someone is singing.
grammars.exampleCn: 看！他们正在踢足球。听！有人在唱歌。

grammars.point: V-ing 变化：一般加 -ing；去 e 加 -ing（make→making）；双写末尾字母加 -ing（run→running, swim→swimming）。
grammars.example: write→writing, sit→sitting, come→coming
grammars.exampleCn: 写→writing，坐→sitting，来→coming

questions.stem: It's 9 p.m. The children ___ now.
questions.analysis: now 提示用现在进行时。

questions.stem: The boy is ___（游泳）in the pool.
questions.analysis: swim 双写 m 加 ing。

questions.stem: —Is your mother cooking? —Yes, ___ is.
questions.analysis: your mother 对应 she。

units.title: Unit 7 It's raining!

words.sentence: Take an umbrella on rainy days.
Children love snowy days.
It is too windy to fly a kite today.
words.sentenceCn: 今天风太大，不适合放风筝。

words.sentence: The sky is cloudy, but it is not cold.
What will the weather be like tomorrow?

grammars.point: 问天气两种句型：How's the weather? = What's the weather like?
grammars.example: How's the weather in Shanghai? It's cloudy.
grammars.exampleCn: 上海天气怎么样？多云。

grammars.point: 雨/雪作动词时可用于现在进行时：It's raining. It's snowing.（it 指天气）
grammars.example: It's raining hard now. Take a raincoat.
grammars.exampleCn: 现在雨下得很大。带上雨衣。

questions.stem: —___ the weather like today? —It's sunny.
questions.analysis: What's the weather like? 固定句型。

questions.stem: It often ___ in summer here.（下雨）
questions.analysis: often 提示一般现在时，it 三单用 rains。

questions.stem: It's ___ today. Let's fly a kite.（有风的）
questions.analysis: 形容词作表语，有风的 = windy。

units.title: Unit 8 Is there a post office near here?

grammars.point: there be 表示"某地有某物"，be 动词与最近的名词保持一致（就近原则）。
grammars.example: There is a bank and two restaurants near here.
grammars.exampleCn: 这附近有一家银行和两家餐馆。

grammars.point: 方位介词：across from（在……对面）、next to（紧挨着）、between...and...（在……和……之间）。
grammars.example: The hotel is across from the bank, next to the park.
grammars.exampleCn: 旅馆在银行对面，紧挨着公园。

questions.stem: ___ there a hospital on Bridge Street?
questions.analysis: a hospital 单数用 Is。

questions.stem: The pay phone is ___ the post office ___ the library.（在……之间）
questions.analysis: between...and... 固定搭配。

questions.stem: Is there a restaurant near here? —Yes, ___.
questions.analysis: there be 问句用 there is 回答。

units.title: Unit 9 What does he look like?

words.sentence: My father is tall and thin.

grammars.point: 问外貌用 What do/does + 主语 + look like?；描述身高体型用 be of medium build/height。
grammars.example: What does your brother look like? He is tall and he has short straight hair.
grammars.exampleCn: 你哥哥长什么样？他很高，留着短直发。

grammars.point: have/has 描述发型的部分（has long curly hair）；be 描述身高体型（is tall/thin）。
grammars.example: She has blonde hair and she is of medium build.
grammars.exampleCn: 她留着金色头发，中等身材。

questions.stem: What ___ your best friend look like?
questions.analysis: 主语三单用 does。

questions.stem: The girl ___ long black hair.
questions.analysis: 头发用 have/has，主语三单用 has。

questions.stem: My father always wears ___.（眼镜）
questions.analysis: glasses 恒为复数形式。

units.title: Unit 10 I'd like some noodles.

words.sentence: The beef noodles smell good.
We ordered two bowls of noodles.
Let me look at the menu first.

grammars.point: would like 表示意愿，缩写 'd like，比 want 更礼貌； Would you like...? 的肯定回答用 Yes, please.
grammars.example: I'd like beef noodles, please.
grammars.exampleCn: 我想要牛肉面。

grammars.point: some 用于肯定句和希望得到肯定回答的问句；any 用于否定句和一般疑问句。
grammars.example: There is some mutton in the soup. Do you have any tea?
grammars.exampleCn: 汤里有一些羊肉。你有茶吗？

questions.stem: —Would you like a large bowl? —___.
questions.analysis: Would you like...? 的肯定回答是 Yes, please。

questions.stem: I'd like ___ mutton in my noodles.（一些）
questions.analysis: 肯定句用 some。

questions.stem: How ___ bowls of noodles do you need?
questions.analysis: bowls 可数，用 how many。

units.title: Unit 11 How was your school trip?

words.sentence: We took a trip to the seaside last month.
words.sentenceCn: 上个月我们去海边旅行了。

words.sentence: The museum is free for students.
What a lovely girl!

grammars.point: 一般过去时表示过去发生的动作，be 动词过去式 am/is→was，are→were。
grammars.example: The trip was excellent. We were very happy.
grammars.exampleCn: 这次旅行棒极了。我们非常开心。

grammars.point: 规则动词过去式在动词后加 -ed；以 e 结尾只加 -d；辅元辅结构双写末尾字母加 -ed。
grammars.example: watch→watched, like→liked, stop→stopped
grammars.exampleCn: 看→watched，喜欢→liked，停止→stopped

questions.stem: —How ___ your weekend? —It ___ great, thanks.
questions.analysis: 过去时 be 动词用 was/were。

questions.stem: I ___（参观）the museum last week.
questions.analysis: last week 提示过去时，visit 加 -ed。

questions.stem: ___ you pick any strawberries on the farm? —Yes, I did.
questions.analysis: 实义动词过去时疑问用 Did。

units.title: Unit 12 What did you do last weekend?

words.sentence: We picked up shells on the beach.
Thousands of people visit the Great Wall every day.
words.sentenceCn: 每天成千上万的人参观长城。

grammars.point: 实义动词过去时：否定用 didn't + 动词原形；疑问用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形。
grammars.example: I didn't do my homework last night. Did you go to the beach?
grammars.exampleCn: 我昨晚没做作业。你去海滩了吗？

grammars.point: 常见不规则动词过去式：go→went, do→did, see→saw, eat→ate, take→took, fly→flew。
grammars.example: We went to the zoo and saw many animals last Sunday.
grammars.exampleCn: 上周日我们去了动物园，看到了很多动物。

questions.stem: What did you do last weekend? —I ___ to the mountains.
questions.analysis: 问句用过去时，答句动词用过去式 went。

questions.stem: She didn't ___ her homework yesterday evening.
questions.analysis: didn't 后接动词原形。

questions.stem: Two days ___, I visited my uncle.（以前）
questions.analysis: 时间段 + ago 表示多久以前。

units.title: Unit 1 Where did you go on vacation?
units.topic: 不定代词与一般过去时

grammars.point: 复合不定代词 someone/anyone/everyone/nobody 等作主语时，谓语动词用单数。
grammars.example: Everyone is here. Nobody knows the answer.
grammars.exampleCn: 每个人都到了。没人知道答案。

grammars.point: 一般过去时：规则动词加 -ed；常见不规则 go→went, buy→bought, see→saw, eat→ate。
grammars.example: I went to the mountains and bought a gift.
grammars.exampleCn: 我去了山区并买了一份礼物。

questions.stem: —Did you go ___ special? —No, I just stayed at home.
questions.analysis: 疑问句用 anywhere 表示"任何地方"。

questions.stem: Everyone ___ here, so we can start the meeting.
questions.analysis: 复合不定代词作主语谓语用单数。

questions.stem: He ___ a new book yesterday.（买）
questions.analysis: buy 过去式是不规则 bought。

units.title: Unit 2 How often do you exercise?

words.sentence: Exercise for half an hour every day.
Health is more important than wealth.

grammars.point: How often 询问动作发生的频率，回答用 always/usually/often/sometimes/hardly ever/never 或具体次数。
grammars.example: —How often do you read? —Twice a week.
grammars.exampleCn: 你多久读一次书？一周两次。

grammars.point: 频度副词位于 be 动词之后、实义动词之前；hardly 本身含否定意味。
grammars.example: He is never late. She hardly ever watches TV.
grammars.exampleCn: 他从不迟到。她几乎不看电视。

questions.stem: —___ do you go to the movies? —Once a month.
questions.analysis: 问频率用 How often。

questions.stem: My sister ___ exercises, so she is not very healthy.
questions.analysis: hardly ever 几乎不，与"不健康"呼应。

questions.stem: About thirty ___ of the students like sports.
questions.analysis: percent 无复数形式。

units.title: Unit 3 I'm more outgoing than my sister.

words.sentence: Which team won the game?

grammars.point: 两者比较用比较级：单音节词加 -er，多音节词用 more + 原级；than 引出比较对象。
grammars.example: Tom is taller than me. She speaks more loudly.
grammars.exampleCn: 汤姆比我高。她说话更大声。

grammars.point: good/well 的比较级是 better，bad 的比较级是 worse。
grammars.example: He does better than last time.
grammars.exampleCn: 他做得比上次好。

questions.stem: This book is ___ than that one.
questions.analysis: 两者比较用比较级 more interesting。

questions.stem: Lucy sings ___ (well) than her sister.
questions.analysis: well 的比较级是 better。

questions.stem: Who runs ___ (fast), Tom or Jim?
questions.analysis: 两者比较用比较级 faster。

units.title: Unit 4 What's the best movie theater?

grammars.point: 三者或三者以上比较用最高级：the + 形容词最高级（-est 或 most + 原级）。
grammars.example: This is the most comfortable seat.
grammars.exampleCn: 这是最舒适的座位。

grammars.point: 副词最高级前的 the 常可省略；比较范围常用 of / in 引出。
grammars.example: He sings (the) best in our class.
grammars.exampleCn: 他在我们班唱得最好。

questions.stem: Which is ___ movie theater in town?
questions.analysis: 三者以上用最高级 the best。

questions.stem: She did ___ (badly) of all the students.
questions.analysis: of all 表示范围，用最高级 worst。

questions.stem: You should listen to the teacher ___ (careful).
questions.analysis: 范围隐含全体，用最高级。

units.title: Unit 5 Do you want to watch a game show?

grammars.point: want/hope/plan/decide 等动词后接不定式 to do 作宾语，不接动名词。
grammars.example: I want to watch a game show. He hopes to visit Beijing.
grammars.exampleCn: 我想看比赛节目。他希望游览北京。

grammars.point: 询问看法：What do you think of...? = How do you like...? 回答用 I love / I don't mind / I can't stand。
grammars.example: What do you think of the news? I don't mind it.
grammars.exampleCn: 你觉得这新闻怎样？我不介意。

questions.stem: I can't ___ (stand) the noise.
questions.analysis: can't 后接动词原形。

questions.stem: He expects ___ (be) a reporter.
questions.analysis: expect 后接不定式 to be。

questions.stem: —What do you ___ of the talk show? —I love it.
questions.analysis: What do you think of...? 固定搭配。

units.title: Unit 6 I'm going to study computer science.

words.sentence: The scientist spent ten years on the research.
words.sentenceCn: 这位科学家花了十年做研究。

grammars.point: be going to + 动词原形表示打算、计划或即将发生的事；主语随人称变 be。
grammars.example: I am going to study medicine. She is going to be a teacher.
grammars.exampleCn: 我打算学医。她打算当老师。

grammars.point: 一般将来时的时间状语：tomorrow, next week, in the future 等。
grammars.example: We are going to have a party next Sunday.
grammars.exampleCn: 下周日我们要开派对。

questions.stem: He ___ (go) to visit his grandma this weekend.
questions.analysis: 计划性将来用 be going to。

questions.stem: What are you going to ___ when you grow up?
questions.analysis: be going to 后接动词原形 be。

questions.stem: They ___ a meeting tomorrow afternoon.
questions.analysis: 将来计划用 are going to have。

units.title: Unit 7 Will people have robots?

words.sentence: Robots will do more housework in the future.
words.sentenceCn: 将来机器人会做更多家务。

words.sentence: Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
words.sentenceCn: 空气污染是大城市的严重问题。

words.sentence: We should do something to protect the environment.
words.sentenceCn: 我们应该为保护环境做些事。

grammars.point: will + 动词原形表示一般将来时，无人称和数的变化，否定 won't。
grammars.example: There will be more robots. People won't use money.
grammars.exampleCn: 会有更多机器人。人们将不用钱。

grammars.point: There will be... 是将来存在句，be 永远用 be 原形。
grammars.example: There will be less pollution in the future.
grammars.exampleCn: 未来污染会更少。

questions.stem: I think kids ___ (not) go to school in 100 years.
questions.analysis: will 的否定 won't。

questions.stem: ___ there be more trees on the earth?
questions.analysis: 将来存在句用 Will there be。

questions.stem: Robots will do ___ (danger) jobs for us.
questions.analysis: 修饰 jobs 用形容词 dangerous。

units.title: Unit 8 How do you make a banana milk shake?

grammars.point: 祈使句以动词原形开头表示步骤或命令；turn on 打开，turn off 关闭。
grammars.example: First, peel the bananas. Then turn on the blender.
grammars.exampleCn: 首先剥香蕉。然后打开搅拌器。

grammars.point: 不可数名词（yogurt, honey, milk）前不加 a/an，表数量用 a cup of / two spoons of。
grammars.example: Add a cup of yogurt.
grammars.exampleCn: 加入一杯酸奶。

questions.stem: ___ the milk into the blender.（倒）
questions.analysis: 祈使句用动词原形开头。

questions.stem: We need two ___ of honey.（勺）
questions.analysis: two 后用复数 spoons。

questions.stem: ___ , mix it all together.
questions.analysis: 句首用副词 Finally。

units.title: Unit 9 Can you come to my party?

grammars.point: 用 Can you come to...? 发出邀请，肯定回答 Sure, I'd love to. 否定回答 Sorry, I can't. + 理由。
grammars.example: —Can you come to my party? —Sure, I'd love to.
grammars.exampleCn: 你能来派对吗？当然，我很乐意。

grammars.point: 用 have to 说明无法赴约的客观理由。
grammars.example: I can't go, because I have to study for a test.
grammars.exampleCn: 我去不了，因为我要备考。

questions.stem: —Can you come to my birthday party? —___, I'd love to.
questions.analysis: 乐意前往用 Sure, I'd love to。

questions.stem: I'm afraid I ___ (can) go, I have too much homework.
questions.analysis: can 否定直接 can't。

questions.stem: —Would you like to join us? —___.
questions.analysis: Would you like 肯定答 Yes, I'd love to。

units.title: Unit 10 If you go to the party, you'll have a great time!

words.sentence: Travel broadens the mind.
Don't be angry with him; he is only a child.
words.sentenceCn: 别生他的气，他只是个孩子。

grammars.point: if 引导条件状语从句，遵循"主将从现"：主句用一般将来时，if 从句用一般现在时。
grammars.example: If it rains, we will stay at home.
grammars.exampleCn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家。

grammars.point: advice 是不可数名词，表示"一条建议"用 a piece of advice，不能说 an advice。
grammars.example: Let me give you a piece of advice.
grammars.exampleCn: 让我给你一条建议。

questions.stem: If you ___ hard, you ___ get good grades.
questions.analysis: 主将从现：从句现在时，主句将来时。

questions.stem: We need some ___ (advice) on this problem.
questions.analysis: advice 不可数，无复数。

questions.stem: If he ___ (be) free, he will call you.
questions.analysis: if 从句用一般现在时 is。

units.title: Unit 1 What's the matter?

words.sentence: The boy has a high fever.
You should drink more water when you cough.
Take a rest after long study.
words.sentenceCn: 长时间学习后要休息一下。

grammars.point: What's the matter (with you)? = What's wrong? 询问身体状况。
grammars.example: What's the matter? I have a headache.
grammars.exampleCn: 怎么了？我头痛。

grammars.point: should / shouldn't 表示建议；should 后接动词原形。
grammars.example: You should lie down and rest. You shouldn't eat too much.
grammars.exampleCn: 你应该躺下休息。你不该吃太多。

questions.stem: —What's the ___ with you? —I have a cold.
questions.analysis: What's the matter 固定搭配。

questions.stem: You ___ (should) drink some hot water.
questions.analysis: should 后接动词原形。

questions.stem: He has a ___ (stomach), so he can't go to school.
questions.analysis: 胃痛 stomachache。

units.title: Unit 2 I'll help to clean up the city parks.
units.topic: 动词不定式与短语动词

words.sentence: The volunteers clean the beach every month.
words.sentenceCn: 志愿者每个月清理海滩。

words.sentence: The old man feels lonely sometimes.
words.sentenceCn: 这位老人有时感到孤独。

grammars.point: 动词不定式 to do 可作宾语或目的状语；help (to) do 中 to 可省。
grammars.example: I want to help to clean up the park.
grammars.exampleCn: 我想帮忙打扫公园。

grammars.point: 短语动词：clean up 打扫，give out 分发，cheer up 使振奋（代词宾语放中间）。
grammars.example: We gave them out. / We cheered him up.
grammars.exampleCn: 我们分发给了他们。我们让他振奋起来。

questions.stem: We should help ___ (clean) up the city parks.
questions.analysis: help 后 to 可省略。

questions.stem: The boy is ___ (孤独的) because he has no friends.
questions.analysis: lonely 强调内心孤独。

questions.stem: They plan ___ (raise) money for the poor kids.
questions.analysis: plan 后接不定式。

units.title: Unit 3 Could you please clean your room?

words.sentence: Please put the rubbish into the bin.

grammars.point: Could you please + 动词原形 提出礼貌请求；回答 Sure / No problem。
grammars.example: Could you please take out the rubbish?
grammars.exampleCn: 请你把垃圾倒掉好吗？

grammars.point: neither 表示"两者都不"，谓语用单数；Me neither. 表示"我也不"。
grammars.example: Neither of them likes coffee. —I don't like it. —Me neither.
grammars.exampleCn: 他们俩都不喜欢咖啡。我也不喜欢。

questions.stem: Could you please ___ (not) make noise?
questions.analysis: Could you please 后接 not + 动词原形。

questions.stem: ___ of the two books is interesting.
questions.analysis: 两者都不用 Neither。

questions.stem: He ___ (sweep) the floor yesterday.
questions.analysis: sweep 过去式 swept。

units.title: Unit 4 Why don't you talk to your parents?

words.meaning: 协议；交易（deal with 处理）

grammars.point: Why don't you...? = Why not...? 后接动词原形，用于提建议。
grammars.example: Why don't you talk to your parents? = Why not talk to them?
grammars.exampleCn: 你为什么不跟你父母谈谈？

grammars.point: 提建议还可说 You should... / You could... / What about doing...?
grammars.example: What about writing a letter?
grammars.exampleCn: 写封信怎么样？

questions.stem: Why ___ you ask the teacher for help?
questions.analysis: Why don't you...? 固定句型。

questions.stem: You ___ (should) argue with your brother.
questions.analysis: 提出建议"不该争吵"用 shouldn't。

questions.stem: What about ___ (go) for a walk?
questions.analysis: What about 后接动名词。

units.title: Unit 5 What were you doing when the rainstorm came?

grammars.point: 过去进行时 was/were + V-ing 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作。
grammars.example: I was reading when the rainstorm came.
grammars.exampleCn: 暴风雨来时我正在读书。

grammars.point: when 引导的从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时，表示"长动作被短动作打断"。
grammars.example: When you called, I was taking a shower.
grammars.exampleCn: 你打电话时我正在洗澡。

questions.stem: At 8 last night, I ___ (watch) TV.
questions.analysis: 过去某时刻用过去进行时。

questions.stem: What ___ you ___ (do) when it began to rain?
questions.analysis: when 从句过去时，主句过去进行时。

questions.stem: She ___ (read) a book at that time.
questions.analysis: at that time 提示过去进行时。

units.title: Unit 6 An old man tried to move the mountains.

grammars.point: try to do 表示"努力去做"（未必成功）；try doing 表示"试着做"。
grammars.example: He tried to move the mountain. Try calling him again.
grammars.exampleCn: 他努力移山。再试着打他电话。

grammars.point: 连词 unless（除非）= if...not；as soon as（一……就）；so...that（如此……以至于）。
grammars.example: As soon as I got home, it rained. He was so tired that he slept.
grammars.exampleCn: 我一回家就下雨了。他太累以至于睡着了。

questions.stem: You won't pass the exam ___ you study hard.
questions.analysis: unless = if not。

questions.stem: He was ___ tired ___ he fell asleep.（如此……以至于）
questions.analysis: so + 形容词 + that。

questions.stem: My mother reminds me ___ (wear) a coat.
questions.analysis: remind sb to do。

units.title: Unit 7 What's the highest mountain in the world?

words.sentence: Thousands of tourists come to Beijing every year.
words.sentenceCn: 每年有成千上万的游客来北京。

grammars.point: 大数表达：thousand（千）/ million（百万）/ billion（十亿），具体数字后不加 s。
grammars.example: The river is about 6,300 kilometers long.
grammars.exampleCn: 这条河约 6300 公里长。

grammars.point: 比较级 + and + 比较级 表示"越来越……"；the + 比较级..., the + 比较级... 表示"越……越……"。
grammars.example: Our country is getting stronger and stronger.
grammars.exampleCn: 我们的国家越来越强大。

questions.stem: The population of China is ___ (large) than that of Japan.
questions.analysis: 人口多用 large，比较级 larger。

questions.stem: It's getting ___ (warm) and ___ (warm).
questions.analysis: 比较级叠加表"越来越"。

questions.stem: Qomolangma is the ___ (high) mountain in the world.
questions.analysis: 三者以上最高级 highest。

units.title: Unit 8 Have you read Treasure Island yet?

words.sentence: Hainan is a famous island in China.
words.sentenceCn: 海南是中国著名的岛屿。

grammars.point: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词 表示过去发生、与现在有关的动作；yet 用于疑问/否定，already 用于肯定。
grammars.example: Have you read it yet? I have already finished.
grammars.exampleCn: 你读过了吗？我已经读完了。

grammars.point: 过去分词：规则加 -ed；不规则如 read→read, write→written, see→seen。
grammars.example: She has written three letters.
grammars.exampleCn: 她写了三封信。

questions.stem: —___ you ___ (read) the book yet? —No, not yet.
questions.analysis: 现在完成时 yet 用 Have...read。

questions.stem: I have ___ (finish) my homework already.
questions.analysis: 现在完成时 have finished。

questions.stem: She has ___ (write) a new song.
questions.analysis: write 过去分词 written。

units.title: Unit 9 Have you ever been to a museum?

words.sentence: I brought my camera to take photos.

words.meaning: 娱乐；游戏（amusement park 游乐场）

words.sentence: The paper is one of the four great inventions of China.
words.sentenceCn: 纸是中国四大发明之一。

grammars.point: have been to 表示"去过某地（已回来）"；have gone to 表示"去了某地（未回来）"。
grammars.example: I have been to Beijing twice. He has gone to the library.
grammars.exampleCn: 我去过北京两次。他去图书馆了。

grammars.point: ever（曾经）/ never（从未）常用于现在完成时；ever 多用于疑问句和肯定句。
grammars.example: Have you ever been to a museum? I have never seen snow.
grammars.exampleCn: 你去过博物馆吗？我从未见过雪。

questions.stem: —Where is Tom? —He ___ to the teacher's office.
questions.analysis: 人不在，用 has gone to。

questions.stem: I ___ never ___ (be) to Shanghai.
questions.analysis: 现在完成时 have been。

questions.stem: ___ you ever ___ (try) Chinese food?
questions.analysis: ever 用于现在完成时 Have...tried。

units.title: Unit 10 I've had this bike for three years.

words.meaning: 院子（yard sale 庭院拍卖）

grammars.point: 现在完成时 + for + 时间段 / since + 时间点 表示动作或状态持续至今。
grammars.example: I have had this bike for three years. He has lived here since 2010.
grammars.exampleCn: 这辆自行车我买了三年。他从2010年起住这。

grammars.point: for 后接时间段（for two days），since 后接时间点（since last Monday）。
grammars.example: She has learned English since she was ten.
grammars.exampleCn: 她从十岁起学英语。

questions.stem: I have kept the book ___ two weeks.
questions.analysis: 时间段前用 for。

questions.stem: He has been ill ___ last Friday.
questions.analysis: 时间点前用 since。

questions.stem: We ___ (know) each other for a long time.
questions.analysis: for 段时间用现在完成时。

units.title: Unit 1 How can we become good learners?

grammars.point: by + 动名词 表示方式、手段（by reading aloud）。
grammars.example: I learn English by watching movies.
grammars.exampleCn: 我通过看电影学英语。

grammars.point: 疑问词 + 不定式 可作宾语：how to learn, what to do, where to go。
grammars.example: I don't know how to pronounce this word.
grammars.exampleCn: 我不知道这个单词怎么发音。

questions.stem: He improves his English ___ reading aloud.
questions.analysis: 表方式用 by + doing。

questions.stem: Do you know how ___ (solve) the problem?
questions.analysis: 疑问词 + 不定式。

questions.stem: We should practice ___ (speak) English every day.
questions.analysis: practice 后接动名词。

units.title: Unit 2 I think that mooncakes are delicious!

words.sentence: People eat mooncakes at Mid-Autumn Festival.
Children carry lanterns at the Lantern Festival.
words.sentenceCn: 孩子们在元宵节提灯笼。

grammars.point: that 引导宾语从句，that 在口语中常省略，从句用陈述语序。
grammars.example: I think (that) mooncakes are delicious.
grammars.exampleCn: 我觉得月饼很好吃。

grammars.point: whether / if 引导含"是否"的宾语从句；从句时态与主句呼应。
grammars.example: I wonder whether the bank is open.
grammars.exampleCn: 我想知道银行是否开门。

questions.stem: I think ___ he will come soon.
questions.analysis: that 引导宾语从句。

questions.stem: Could you tell me ___ the train leaves?
questions.analysis: 是否用 if/whether。

questions.stem: She said ___ she was tired.
questions.analysis: 陈述事实用 that。

units.title: Unit 3 Could you please tell me where the restrooms are?
units.topic: 宾语从句（二）与礼貌问路

words.sentence: She sent me a postcard from Yunnan.
words.sentenceCn: 她从云南给我寄了一张明信片。

grammars.point: 宾语从句必须用陈述语序（主语在前，谓语在后），即使是疑问句转换而来。
grammars.example: Could you tell me where the bank is?
grammars.exampleCn: 你能告诉我银行在哪吗？

grammars.point: 礼貌请求：Could you please tell me...? / Do you know where...? 比直接问更得体。
grammars.example: Excuse me, do you know how to get to the library?
grammars.exampleCn: 打扰一下，你知道怎么去图书馆吗？

questions.stem: Could you tell me ___ ?
questions.analysis: 从句用陈述语序。

questions.stem: I don't know ___ to get there.
questions.analysis: 疑问词 + 不定式。

questions.stem: Pardon? 的意思是：___
questions.analysis: Pardon 用于没听清请重复。

units.title: Unit 4 I used to be afraid of the dark.

words.sentence: He is always helpful to others.
Our team scored three goals.

grammars.point: used to + 动词原形 表示"过去常常（现在已不）"；否定 used not to / didn't use to。
grammars.example: I used to be afraid of the dark.
grammars.exampleCn: 我过去怕黑。

grammars.point: be used to doing 表示"习惯于做某事"，to 是介词，后接动名词。
grammars.example: She is used to getting up early.
grammars.exampleCn: 她习惯早起。

questions.stem: He ___ (use) to play soccer after school.
questions.analysis: used to 表过去习惯。

questions.stem: My father is used to ___ (read) newspapers at night.
questions.analysis: be used to doing。

questions.stem: Did you use to ___ (be) short?
questions.analysis: used to 后接动词原形。

units.title: Unit 5 What are the shirts made of?

grammars.point: 一般现在时被动语态：am/is/are + 及物动词过去分词；主语是动作承受者。
grammars.example: The shirts are made of cotton.
grammars.exampleCn: 这些衬衫是棉制的。

grammars.point: be made of（看出原料）/ be made from（看不出原料）区别。
grammars.example: Paper is made from wood. The desk is made of wood.
grammars.exampleCn: 纸由木头制成（看不出）。桌子由木头制成（看出）。

questions.stem: The kite ___ (make) of paper.
questions.analysis: 被动 be made of。

questions.stem: Wine is made ___ grapes.
questions.analysis: 看不出原料用 from。

questions.stem: English ___ (speak) in many countries.
questions.analysis: 一般现在时被动 is spoken。

units.title: Unit 6 When was it invented?

words.sentence: Edison invented the light bulb.

grammars.point: 一般过去时被动语态：was/were + 过去分词；常用 by 引出动作执行者。
grammars.example: The telephone was invented by Bell.
grammars.exampleCn: 电话是贝尔发明的。

grammars.point: 被动语态把动作的承受者作主语，强调事实或结果而非执行者。
grammars.example: When was the car invented? It was invented in 1885.
grammars.exampleCn: 汽车何时发明？1885年。

questions.stem: The light bulb ___ (invent) by Edison.
questions.analysis: 过去被动 was invented。

questions.stem: When ___ the Internet ___ (create)?
questions.analysis: 过去时被动 was created。

questions.stem: Paper ___ (make) in China long ago.
questions.analysis: long ago 过去被动。

units.title: Unit 7 Teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes.

words.sentence: Safety comes first when we swim.

grammars.point: 含情态动词的被动：情态动词 + be + 过去分词（must be done, should be allowed）。
grammars.example: Teenagers should be allowed to choose their clothes.
grammars.exampleCn: 青少年应该被允许选择自己的衣服。

grammars.point: be allowed to do 表示"被允许做"；allow sb to do 的被动形式。
grammars.example: We are not allowed to smoke here.
grammars.exampleCn: 我们不被允许在此吸烟。

questions.stem: Students should ___ (allow) to wear their own clothes.
questions.analysis: 情态被动 should be allowed。

questions.stem: Smoking is ___ (harm) to your health.
questions.analysis: be harmful to 固定。

questions.stem: The work must ___ (finish) today.
questions.analysis: must 被动 be finished。

units.title: Unit 8 It must belong to Carla.

grammars.point: 情态动词表推测：must（一定，把握最大）/ might, could（可能）/ can't（不可能，把握大）。
grammars.example: The book must be Linda's. It can't be Tom's.
grammars.exampleCn: 这书一定是琳达的。不可能是汤姆的。

grammars.point: belong to 表示"属于"，无被动语态和进行时；to 后接名词或代词宾格。
grammars.example: This coat belongs to Carla.
grammars.exampleCn: 这件外套是卡拉的。

questions.stem: The hair band ___ (must) be Lily's. She loves pink.
questions.analysis: 把握大用 must。

questions.stem: It ___ be John's. He doesn't wear a coat like this.
questions.analysis: 否定推测用 can't。

questions.stem: The notebook belongs ___ Lucy.
questions.analysis: belong to 固定搭配。

units.title: Unit 9 I like music that I can dance to.

words.meaning: 关闭；关上（过去/过分 shut）

grammars.point: that / which 引导定语从句修饰物，在从句中作主语或宾语。
grammars.example: I like music that I can dance to. The book which is on the desk is mine.
grammars.exampleCn: 我喜欢能跟着跳舞的音乐。桌上的书是我的。

grammars.point: 关系代词作宾语时可省略；先行词被最高级修饰时常用 that。
grammars.example: This is the best film (that) I have seen.
grammars.exampleCn: 这是我看过的最好的电影。

questions.stem: I like the songs ___ are written by him.
questions.analysis: 修饰物用 that/which。

questions.stem: He prefers ___ (listen) to quiet music.
questions.analysis: prefer to do。

questions.stem: The movie ___ we saw yesterday was boring.
questions.analysis: 修饰物，that/which 作宾语可省。

units.title: Unit 10 You're supposed to shake hands.

grammars.point: be supposed to do 表示"应该/被期望做"（按习俗或规定）。
grammars.example: You're supposed to shake hands when you meet.
grammars.exampleCn: 见面时你应该握手。

grammars.point: be expected to do 也表示"被期望做"；不同国家 greeting 习俗不同（bow/kiss/hug）。
grammars.example: In Japan people are expected to bow.
grammars.exampleCn: 在日本人们应该鞠躬。

questions.stem: In China, you ___ (suppose) to shake hands.
questions.analysis: be supposed to。

questions.stem: You ___ (expect) to be on time.
questions.analysis: be expected to。

questions.stem: People in France often ___ (kiss) when they meet.
questions.analysis: 主语复数一般现在时 kiss。

units.title: Unit 11 Sad movies make me cry.

words.sentence: Father drives me to school on rainy days.
words.sentenceCn: 雨天爸爸开车送我上学。

grammars.point: make + 宾语 + 形容词 / 动词原形：make me cry（使我哭），make him happy（使他开心）。
grammars.example: Sad movies make me want to leave.
grammars.exampleCn: 悲剧让我想离开。

grammars.point: make 作使役动词，后接不带 to 的不定式（make sb do），被动时补 to（be made to do）。
grammars.example: The noise made me angry. He was made to clean the room.
grammars.exampleCn: 噪音使我生气。他被迫打扫房间。

questions.stem: The good news made us ___ (excited).
questions.analysis: make + 宾语 + 形容词。

questions.stem: The teacher made him ___ (stand) outside.
questions.analysis: make sb do 用原形。

questions.stem: Loud music always makes me ___ (want) to dance.
questions.analysis: make 后接动词原形。

units.title: Unit 12 Life is full of the unexpected.

grammars.point: 过去完成时 had + 过去分词 表示"过去的过去"，即先于另一过去动作发生。
grammars.example: When I got there, the bus had left.
grammars.exampleCn: 我到那时，公交车已经走了。

grammars.point: by the time + 过去时从句，主句常用过去完成时。
grammars.example: By the time I woke up, it had stopped raining.
grammars.exampleCn: 我醒来时雨已经停了。

questions.stem: By the time she arrived, the meeting ___ (begin).
questions.analysis: 过去的过去用过去完成时。

questions.stem: I ___ (never see) such a film before that day.
questions.analysis: before that day 用过去完成时。

questions.stem: The train ___ (leave) when we got to the station.
questions.analysis: got 之前用 had left。

units.title: Unit 13 We're trying to save the earth!

grammars.point: 现在进行时被动：am/is/are + being + 过去分词，强调此刻正在被做。
grammars.example: The river is being polluted.
grammars.exampleCn: 这条河正在被污染。

grammars.point: 现在完成时被动：have/has + been + 过去分词，强调动作对现在的影响。
grammars.example: A lot of trees have been planted.
grammars.exampleCn: 已经种了很多树。

questions.stem: The bridge ___ (build) now.
questions.analysis: 此刻正在被建用现在进行时被动。

questions.stem: Many trees ___ (plant) since last year.
questions.analysis: since 用现在完成时被动。

questions.stem: We should stop ___ (throw) litter.
questions.analysis: stop doing 停止做某事。

units.title: Unit 14 I remember meeting all of you in Grade 7.

grammars.point: remember/forget + doing 表示"记得/忘记做过的事"；+ to do 表示"记得/忘记要去做的事"。
grammars.example: I remember meeting you. Remember to lock the door.
grammars.exampleCn: 我记得见过你。记得锁门。

grammars.point: 动名词作主语或宾语
grammars.example: Reading is fun. I look forward to seeing you.
grammars.exampleCn: 阅读很有趣。我期待见到你。

questions.stem: I remember ___ (meet) him before.
questions.analysis: 记得做过用 meeting。

questions.stem: Please remember ___ (lock) the door.
questions.analysis: 记得去做用 to lock。

questions.stem: ___ (read) in the sun is bad for your eyes.
questions.analysis: 动名词作主语。

questions.stem: Two days ___, I visited my uncle.（以前）
questions.analysis: 时间段 + ago 表示多久以前。
